description: Header file defining the OmxGraphicBufferSource class and related wrapper classes for media OMX buffer source in Android's media framework.

classes.name: TWGraphicBufferSource
classes.description: Wrapper class for IGraphicBufferSource with additional methods and internal references to OmxGraphicBufferSource.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the OMX buffer source with a given OMX node and dataspace.

methods.name: setSuspend
methods.description: Sets the suspend state of the buffer source.

methods.name: setRepeatPreviousFrameDelayUs
methods.description: Sets delay for repeating previous frame.

methods.name: setMaxFps
methods.description: Sets the maximum frames per second.

methods.name: setStartTimeUs
methods.description: Sets the start time in microseconds.

methods.name: setStopTimeUs
methods.description: Sets the stop time in microseconds.

methods.name: setColorAspects
methods.description: Sets color aspects for the buffer source.

methods.name: setTimeOffsetUs
methods.description: Sets the time offset in microseconds.

methods.name: signalEndOfInputStream
methods.description: Signals the end of input stream.
